gloss: to wander into; to stray into

definitions.gloss: to wander into; to stray into
definitions.explanation: to accidentally enter an unfamiliar place while lost or confused

examples.japanese: {道|みち}に{迷|まよ}って{知|し}らない{路地|ろじ}に{迷|まよ}い{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I got lost and wandered into an unfamiliar alley.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}が{庭|にわ}に{迷|まよ}い{込|こ}んできた。
examples.english: A cat wandered into the garden.

examples.japanese: {異世界|いせかい}に{迷|まよ}い{込|こ}んだような{気分|きぶん}になった。
examples.english: I felt like I had wandered into another world.

notes:
FORMATION:
{迷|まよ}う (to get lost, be confused) + {込|こ}む (to go into) → to go into while lost

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb - the subject wanders into somewhere.

RELATED ～{込|こ}む COMPOUND VERBS:
- {飛|と}び{込|こ}む (to jump into)
- {投|な}げ{込|こ}む (to throw into)
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}む (to rush into)
- {入|はい}り{込|こ}む (to enter, get into)

NUANCE:
Implies accidental or unintentional entry, often with a sense of being lost or confused.
